title: Plural affirmative olla
summary: Match me, te, and he with olemme, olette, and ovat.
objectives: Form me olemme, te olette, and he ovat.
Use plural agreement in complete sentences.
Apply olette to plural and polite-singular te.

sections.title: Three plural forms
paragraphs: The plural present-tense forms are olemme, olette, and ovat. Each belongs to one subject pronoun.
Use me olemme, te olette, and he ovat.

sections.title: Te keeps plural agreement
paragraphs: When te addresses a group, use olette. When te addresses one person politely, also use olette.
The supplied locations do not change, so concentrate on the subject and verb pair.

steps: Te addresses a group or one person politely.
He refers to a group of people.

commonMistakes: Do not pair me with ovat.
Do not use singular agreement for polite te.
Do not replace he with a non-person pronoun in this pack.
